what: Hand-labelled GATE-ROW set for docs/jev-integration-plan.md 2차 #2 (per-FAIL-row triage).
how: Every bgrun log under tools/bench/ modified 2026-09-21..22 whose LAST run contains at least one `FAIL` row was dumped (row text only, no Jev call). The material session of 2026-09-22 read the rows and labelled them BEFORE any API call was made. Where one file repeats one row shape (the S-F twin of every S-T row, the three identical boolcarrier candidates, the ten NOT-REACHED cascade rows of row2b) only a representative subset was taken, so no single file dominates the set.

classes.defect: the artefact or the edit really is wrong and the row reports it correctly (ExecState 0 after a mutation, an op that minted nothing, a wire on the wrong net, a real leak, our own code raising)
classes.prediction-error: the machine reading is fine and the GATE's expectation was wrong (a mis-derived count, name or position), or the row is a bookkeeping consequence of a stage deliberately skipped/deferred/not reached, so nothing was measured
classes.reading-artefact: neither is wrong - the READER could not see the thing (error 1055, no Nodes[] index, an empty terminal table, None from a property read) and the no-answer is printed as if it were a measurement

matching: `starts` is matched against ' '.join(line.split()) of each FAIL row of the log's LAST run (tools/bench/jev_gaterow_q.fail_rows). It is a prefix, unique within its file.
labelled_by: material session, 2026-09-22, from the row text and its context only
